<module id="freq_div">
	<description>Frequency Divider for generating different clock frequencies based on the input clock signal.</description>
	
	<ports>
		<input id="CLK_in">Input clock signal with a frequency of 100MHz.</input>
		<input id="RST">Reset signal used to initialize the module.</input>
		
		<output id="CLK_50">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 2.</output>
		<output id="CLK_10">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 10.</output>
		<output id="CLK_1">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 100.</output>
	end
	
	<implementation>Implements a frequency divider using two counters, one for dividing by 2 and another for dividing by 10.</implementation>
	
	<logic_description type="combinational_logic">
		<reg id="cnt_10" width_description="[3:0]">Counter for dividing CLK_in by 10.</reg>
		<reg id="cnt_100" width_description="[6:0]">Counter for dividing CLK_in by 100.</reg>
		
		<always @(posedge CLK_in or posedge RST)>
			if(RST) begin
				cnt_10 <= 4'd0;
			end else if(cnt_10 == 4'd4) begin
				cnt_10 <= 4'd0;
			end else begin
				cnt_10 <= cnt_10 + 1;
			end
		end
		
		<assign CLK_10 = ~CLK_10 & (cnt_10 == 4'd4);
		
		
		<always @(posedge CLK_in or posedge RST)> // Counter for CLK_100
			if(RST) begin
				cnt_100 <= 7'd0;
			end else if(cnt_100 == 7'd49) begin
				cnt_100 <= 7'd0;
			end else begin
				cnt_100 <= cnt_100 + 1;
			end
		end</logic_description></ports></module>
